title: Nvidia commits $1.5B to Amkor to expand US chip packaging
summary: Nvidia has agreed to give Amkor Technology a $1.5 billion prepayment to expand advanced semiconductor packaging and testing in the United States, tightening a supply relationship that already sits behind its data-centre chips.
